text: All right, so part of this timeline thing, the detailed log is going to be in the dev bar for exact transcriptions and more real time stuff. But then we're going to work on the AI dashboard on the left. Seems like, yeah, I just got an update about the site is back, what broke it in plain words. This is too wordy. I don't want to read all this. I want to see big cards that represent the big ideas that I've been talking about, kind of organized. And so if I've been talking about a specific thing a bunch, it should be bigger at the top, those are primary things. And so, I mean, the site crashed. So I want a card with a crash icon that says site crash. Timestamped, and then I click on it, and then I can look at more detail about it.
